entries.clue: Frenchman whose stepped rings of glass hurl a small flame's light for miles
Long finger of brightness swinging out across the dark water
Dreaded reef off Plymouth, first lit by Winstanley's daring tower in 1698
Scots engineering dynasty of the lights; one grandson wrote Treasure Island
Tiny mirror-bright disc sewn in rows to make a costume glitter
Space under the rafters, dusty home to boxes nobody opens
Strip you step over on the way in, and a limit that must be crossed
Boxed heat behind a door, where the Sunday roast goes
Front seats so close you can hear the horses breathe
Plumed pint-size horse trotting in step with its harnessed fellows
